Features

  • Product details: This white high-gloss sideboard is the perfect size for any interior style, combining functionality and elegance. Measuring 140 x 35 x 80 cm, it fits perfectly into any corner of the house.
  • Storage and display: This dining room cabinet offers both storage and display functions. The open compartments are equipped with LED lights that shine through the glass shelves, creating an inviting ambiance for your belongings.
  • White high-gloss sideboard: The white high-gloss drawer fronts give it an elegant and simple look that blends perfectly into many interior design styles. The tabletop is easy to clean, and the transparent acrylic baffle design adds layered elements to the entire sideboard. (The highlighting is limited to the front.)
  • 3 drawers: The 3-drawer design facilitates storage, providing space for various items and combining open and closed storage to meet your different needs. Items can be conveniently placed and easily accessed on the spacious tabletop. It can also be used to display decorative items such as photos and flowers.
  • 2 cabinets with extra-large storage space: The closed sliding door cabinet can meet the storage needs of various items, making storage easier and ensuring order throughout the house!
  • LED lighting: Create the perfect ambiance with 16 captivating colors, 4 dynamic modes, and adjustable brightness via remote control. From cozy evenings to lively gatherings, this modern LED sideboard is suitable for all your needs.
  • Versatile uses: This sideboard can be used not only as a console table in the living room or home office, but also as a coffee bar in the kitchen or dining room. It can also be used as a storage cabinet for books and other home decor. It is a unique piece of furniture that complements any interior design style and adds a touch of elegance to your home.
  • Opt for stylish minimalism: This decorative cabinet combines clean lines with a play of open and closed spaces. Its combination of visual appeal and functionality can enhance any interior design.
  • Easy assembly: Assembling this sideboard is straightforward and child's play thanks to its simple design!
  • Note: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please ensure both packages have arrived before starting assembly!

Image and text description

Description

If the lights do not work, please check the following: 1. Check the connection direction. Try the opposite direction (see illustration). 2. Check the remote control. Remove the plastic cover before use. 3. Keep the remote control away from the receiver. Make sure there are no obstructions between them. 4. For safety reasons, the remote control does not contain batteries. Battery type: CR2025

Description

This white high-gloss sideboard (140 x 35 x 80 cm) impresses with its minimalist design, which blends harmoniously into various interior styles and combines functionality with elegance. LED light strips (with 16 colors and 4 dynamic modes, controllable via remote control) create an inviting ambiance. The lower section features three white high-gloss drawers and two spacious cabinet doors for organized storage. The easy-care acrylic top can be used as a coffee bar, side table, or bookshelf. Please note that the sideboard is delivered in two packages and requires self-assembly. Thanks to its simple construction, assembly is straightforward.Product Specifications
